LESSON: READING 8.2.1 INTENSIVE READING – LEGENDS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends, part of Strand 8 in Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How do you read intensively? 2. Why can an individual be considered a legend in the society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read legendary narratives from various sources,

2. identify legendary characters from stories,

3. work with peers to create mind maps to describe their character using relevant adjectives,

4. share ideas on the unique qualities of the legendary characters,

5. identify vocabulary from the narratives and list them,

6. infer the meaning of the new words from the narratives,

7. answer direct and inferential questions from stories on legends. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read legendary narratives from various sources,
2. identify legendary characters from stories,
3. work with peers to create mind maps to describe their character using relevant adjectives,
4. share ideas on the unique qualities of the legendary characters,
5. identify vocabulary from the narratives and list them,
6. infer the meaning of the new words from the narratives,
7. answer direct and inferential questions from stories on legends. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: This is enhanced as the learner engages in collective learning as they read legendary narratives and

identify the legendary characters with peers.

• Critical Thinking and Problem-solving: It is enhanced as the learner logically analyses concepts when creating mind maps

to describe their character using relevant adjectives.

46

Values:
• Patriotism: This is promoted as the learner reads legendary narratives from various sources.

• Love: This is promoted as the learner portrays a caring attitude by sharing ideas on the unique qualities of the legendary

characters.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cultural Awareness: The learner interacts with indigenous literature on legendary characters.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate with the concept of legends to similar concepts in English and Kiswahili.
